title: Fetch, filter and write a report
prompt: Get the stock list from {{site:api.bench.test}}/v1/inventory and write reorder.csv in the workspace listing every item whose quantity is below its reorder level: header `sku,qty,reorder_level,order_qty`, where order_qty is twice the reorder level minus the quantity, rows sorted by sku.
notes: D-90 equals its level (not below); the list is two pages (the first page links to the second).
